location.evidence_quote: Center for Eating Disorders (Odense University Hospital), Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus University Hospital) and Unit for Psychiatric Research (Aalborg University Hospital)
location.notes: Three recruitment centres in Denmark; applies to the whole cohort.

subject_id.notes: No individual participant IDs are given in the main text; details deferred to Supplementary Tables 1-2, whose actual row-level content is not included in the provided text.

sample_id.notes: No sample accession/barcode IDs are reported in the available text.

subcohort.evidence_quote: the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type
subcohort.notes: AN is subdivided into AN-RS (n=56) and AN-BP (n=21) subtypes; this is an additional stratification beyond the AN/HC grouping chosen as primary subgroup axis for this extraction.

control.evidence_quote: 77 enrolled women with AN and 70 age-matched control women considered to be of healthy weight (HC)
control.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls

country.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark from 1 September 2014 to 31 July 2016

body_site.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples, respectively
body_site.notes: Serum was also sampled for metabolomics but 'serum'/'blood' is not among allowed body_site enum values; feces is the matching microbiome sample type.

days_from_first_collection.notes: Study appears cross-sectional for human cohort; no repeated collection timepoints described for humans.

westernized.notes: Not explicitly stated; participants are Danish Caucasian women recruited in Denmark, which would plausibly be 'Yes', but this is not directly stated in the text.

ncbi_accession.notes: A ClinicalTrials.gov registration (NCT02217384) is mentioned but this is a trial registry ID, not an SRA/ENA sample accession.

age.evidence_quote: Detailed baseline characteristics of study participants are shown in Supplementary Table 2
age.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
age.notes: Cohort described as 'age-matched' but no numeric mean/median age is given in the provided text; deferred to Supplementary Table 2 whose values are not included.

age_group.evidence_quote: it was designed for use in females aged 13–53 years
age_group.notes: This describes the EDI-3 instrument's validated age range, not necessarily the actual participant age range; not used to assign age_group for the cohort.

ancestry.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases

sex.evidence_quote: we decided to include only women in the present study
sex.notes: Applies to both AN and HC groups; whole cohort is female.

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Applies to both AN cases and controls as an exclusion criterion; inferred as 'No' current antibiotic use rather than directly stated as such.

bmi.evidence_quote: women with AN were much leaner
bmi.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
bmi.notes: Qualitative difference reported but no numeric cohort-level BMI value given in main text (deferred to Supplementary Table 1/2). Specific BMI values are reported only for the 6 individual FMT donor subset (3 AN: 10.3, 11.5, 11.7 kg/m^2; 3 HC: 22.6, 21.1, 21.2 kg/m^2) in the Animal experiments section, not representative of the full cohort.

dietary_restriction.evidence_quote: 40–50% carbohydrate (maximum of 10% sugar), 30–40% fat and 20–25% protein
dietary_restriction.notes: Describes clinical nutrition therapy macronutrient composition for AN in-patients during treatment, not a standard dietary_restriction category (e.g., vegan/vegetarian); not mapped to enum values.

disease.evidence_quote: The AN patients were all diagnosed by an experienced consultant psychiatrist and they met the DSM-5 criteria
disease.notes: HC = 'age-matched control women considered to be of healthy weight'.

by_subgroup.AN: Anorexia nervosa (restricting type, AN-RS, or binge-eating/purging type, AN-BP)

disease_details.evidence_quote: a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females
disease_details.notes: Subtypes also reported: 'the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type'.

disease_response_orr.notes: Not an oncology study; ORR not applicable/reported.

disease_response_pfs.notes: Not applicable to this eating-disorder cohort study.

disease_response_recist.notes: Not applicable to this study (no solid tumor assessment).

feces_phenotype.evidence_quote: there was no significant difference in bacterial cell counts between AN and HC
feces_phenotype.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
feces_phenotype.notes: Stool samples were also used for metagenomics, metabolomics, and 16S rRNA sequencing, but these are not classic 'feces phenotype' clinical measures.

fmt_id.notes: No individual participant identifiers (e.g., AN1, HC1) given for FMT donors; only counts and descriptive stats reported.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: Faecal samples from randomly selected subsets of three patients with AN...and three HC...were used to colonize 6-week-old female GF littermates
fmt_role.notes: Applies only to the 3 AN and 3 HC human donors used for FMT; mouse recipients (AN-T/HC-T) are not human participants.

obgyn_birth_control.evidence_quote: regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills
obgyn_birth_control.notes: This describes an exclusion criterion allowance for birth control pills, not actual usage status of participants; cannot assign Yes/No.

smoker.evidence_quote: age, smoking and multiple drug intake
smoker.section: Results — Associations between absolute bacterial abundance and bioclinical variables
smoker.notes: Smoking is used as a covariate in statistical models but no specific smoking status/prevalence value is reported in the main text.

treatment.evidence_quote: Medication included selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors, antipsychotics and benzodiazepines.
treatment.notes: These medications were used as deconfounding covariates, indicating some AN participants were on these treatments.

tumor_staging_ajcc.notes: Not applicable; no cancer staging in this study.

tumor_staging_tnm.notes: Not applicable; no cancer staging in this study.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: three patients with AN (females aged 20, 22 and 20 yr with BMI of 10.3, 11.5 and 11.7 kg m −2
biomarker_name.notes: BMI values are explicitly given per individual FMT donor (see samples array); aggregate cohort biomarker values (glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP) are mentioned qualitatively in Results but exact numbers are reported only in Supplementary Table 2, which is not included in the provided text.

biomarker_value.evidence_quote: three HC (females aged 20, 22 and 21 yr with BMI of 22.6, 21.1 and 21.2 kg m −2, respectively)
biomarker_value.notes: Values correspond to individual FMT donors; see samples array for per-individual mapping.

disease_response_os.evidence_quote: The aggregate mortality rate is estimated to be 5.6% per decade
disease_response_os.notes: This mortality rate is a background/citation statistic (ref. 5), not a measured outcome for this study's own cohort.

ecog_performance_status.notes: Not applicable; this is not an oncology performance-status study.

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: Microbial DNAs were isolated and purified from stool samples (~250 mg) of human donors and mouse recipients by using NucleoSpin soil mini kit (MACHEREY‑NAGEL).
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — DNA extraction, 16S rRNA sequencing and data analyses in mice experiments
dna_extraction_kit.notes: This kit was used for 16S rRNA extraction from human donor and mouse recipient stool samples in the FMT experiment; the main human shotgun metagenomics DNA extraction protocol (IHMS SOP P7 V2) did not specify a commercial kit name.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: Purified and amplified DNA fragment libraries were sequenced using the Ion Proton Sequencer (Thermo Fisher)
sequencing_platform.notes: Primary human faecal shotgun metagenomics used Ion Proton Sequencer; a separate 16S rRNA amplicon analysis of mouse/human donor stool used Illumina MiSeq ('Sequencing was done on an Illumina MiSeq desktop sequencer using the MiSeq reagent kit V3').

host_species.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples, respectively, from a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females.
host_species.notes: Study also includes a mouse model (female germ-free Swiss Webster mice) for faecal microbiota transplantation experiments; both human and mouse hosts are studied, but schema allows only a single enum value so 'Human' is reported as the primary host for the main cohort study, with mouse experiments noted separately.

extraction_warnings: Supplementary Tables 1-8 are referenced extensively in the main text (containing detailed baseline characteristics, clinical variables, and medication data) but their actual row-level numeric content is not included in the provided text, so sample-level or precise subgroup-level numeric values (age, BMI, lab values) could not be extracted.

The paper describes AN-RS and AN-BP subtypes as an additional stratification (n=56 and n=21 respectively) which was not used as the primary subgroup axis here (AN vs HC was used instead) since the schema's 'control' field aligns with Case/Control status.

Six individual FMT donors (3 AN, 3 HC) have specific reported age and BMI values in the Animal experiments methods section, but these were not expanded into sample-level rows since they represent a small subset used for mouse colonization rather than the full human cohort, and lack explicit subject/sample IDs.
No explicit NCBI/SRA/ENA accession numbers for sequencing data were found in the provided text.

Most schema fields (disease_response_*, tumor_staging_*, neonatal_*, obgyn_*, hla, ecog) are not applicable to this gut-microbiota/anorexia-nervosa study and were marked not_reported.

Granularity was set to 'sample_level' only because the Methods — Animal experiments section explicitly lists individual age/BMI values for the 6 human FMT donors (3 AN, 3 HC). The main human cohort (77 AN, 70 HC) is otherwise described only at study/subgroup level, with detailed clinical values reported in Supplementary Tables 1–2, which were not included in the provided text.

Aggregate biomarker values (glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP, cholesterol) are mentioned qualitatively (e.g., 'lower fasting serum concentrations of glucose and insulin') without exact numbers in the provided main text; exact values likely reside in Supplementary Table 2, not available here.
'smoking' and 'medication/drug intake' are used only as statistical covariates in the paper; specific prevalence values per participant/subgroup were not stated in the provided text.
Treatment list (SSRIs, antipsychotics, benzodiazepines) applies to a subset of AN participants used for deconfounding, not necessarily all 77 AN cases.
